summary: No security findings. Cap enforcement: legalActions now gates both raise branches on state.betCount < STREET_BET_CAP; applyAction rejects any action not in legalActions (type+amount match) with 'illegal-action', and the only src callers that advance a hand (src/table/session.ts, src/playtest/runner.ts) go through applyAction, so a 5th raise is rejected on every path. The 'bet' branch is reachable only when currentBet == 0, i.e. betCount == 0 (preflop starts at betCount 1 with currentBet = BB), so it cannot exceed the cap. betCount resets to 0 in endRound and foldOut. Removing the policy-side filter in randomMovePolicy is safe because the engine is now the single enforcement point (fails closed). Chip-safety fixture (TASK-1.31 locked test): only the AC#1 stake changed to s = 56,294,995,342,130; with the 4-bet cap a player's max commitment is 16s+8 = 900,719,925,474,088, within every stack (headroom 11), 10 x minimumStack = MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 111 sits exactly at the A-4 bound (s+1 would exceed it), and the unchanged assertions (stack total == MAX, every amount Number.isSafeInteger, awards > 0.9 x MAX) still prove the safe-integer guarantee near the limit. Both tests pass locally. No new dependencies, secrets, or trust-boundary changes.
